def _is_optional(anno: Any) ->bool:
    if is_union(anno):
        # Check if this is a Union containing None
        args = getattr(anno, "__args__", None)
        if args is not None:
            # A Union is optional if it contains NoneType
            return any(arg is NoneType or arg == NoneType for arg in args)
    return False
